bootstrap.calendar_span_rule: within each population independently, build one common challenger-shared UTC calendar from min(entry_utc_day) through max(entry_utc_day) inclusive across all admitted cohort positions before policy-specific censoring; retain zero-entry days; every challenger in that population uses this identical calendar
bootstrap.draw_algorithm: replicate ordinal r is zero-based 0..samples-1 and block ordinal b is zero-based starting at 0; substitute seed,r,b as unsigned base-10 ASCII integers with no leading plus sign and no leading zeros except the single digit 0; hash the exact ASCII bytes GUARDIAN_POLICY_BOOTSTRAP_V1|<seed>|<r>|<b> with no trailing newline; start_index=uint64_be(first_8_bytes(SHA256(bytes))) mod calendar_day_count; append the 7 circular consecutive UTC days from start_index; increment b and repeat until at least calendar_day_count sampled days exist, then truncate to exactly calendar_day_count
bootstrap.familywise_rule: all three challengers share every calendar draw; for each globally valid replicate compute centered_error_i=replicate_mean_delta_bps_i-point_mean_delta_bps_i and max_error=max_i(centered_error_i); critical_95 is nearest-rank q95 of max_error; simultaneous_lower_i=point_mean_delta_bps_i-critical_95
bootstrap.globally_valid_replicate: every challenger has at least one finite paired primary row after applying the sampled UTC-day multiplicities; otherwise discard the replicate for the entire challenger family
bootstrap.quantile_rule: nearest_rank:sort ascending and select index ceil(0.95*n)-1

bound_text_source_hash_rule: for every bound repository text source SHA-256 in this contract, read file bytes, replace each CRLF byte pair with LF, perform no other transformation, then SHA-256 the resulting bytes; this makes the identity invariant to Git core.autocrlf checkout conversion

external_shadow.admission_rule: include every explicitly approved adoption generation that first reaches MANAGED_SHADOW after campaign activation; do not filter by current profit, MFE, age-in-position, subsequent policy outcome, symbol performance, or policy availability
external_shadow.admission_stratum_rule: bind the compatible protection-context-v1 row for the same Futures symbol and 5m primary interval with the greatest candle_close_time_ms strictly less than the MANAGED_SHADOW transition UTC ms among rows already persisted before that transition; require transition_ms-candle_close_time_ms<=600000 and context_freshness_ms<=600000; ties on candle_close_time_ms must have identical context_id or fail closed; if no qualifying row exists, retain the position in the cohort with stratum_unavailable and it cannot satisfy trend-state coverage
external_shadow.campaign_terminal_rule: campaign_end_ms=activation_ms+60*86400000; admit positions only when MANAGED_SHADOW transition_ms satisfies activation_ms<=transition_ms<campaign_end_ms; never extend or terminate early based on policy outcomes, evidence counts, performance, or observed guardrail values; after campaign_end_ms no new admissions occur; allow a fixed 21600000 ms observation tail for already-admitted 72x5m max-holding episodes, then unresolved episodes are censored and insufficient evidence closes fail-closed
external_shadow.selection_time: admission is decided before any candidate-policy outcome for that adoption generation is read

historical_harness.admission_rule: load the frozen base source spec, override only direction_scope to futures_bidirectional, then include every executable USD-M Futures entry produced in its declared evaluation splits before exit-policy substitution; no filtering by realized return, MFE, profit, later market path, or candidate-policy outcome
historical_harness.admission_stratum_rule: use the protection-context-v1 trend_state derived from the same fully closed decision candle that scheduled the next-bar-open entry; require context candle_close_time_ms < entry_time_ms
historical_harness.derived_override_exclusivity: no other BacktestSpec field may differ from the frozen base source
historical_harness.entry_quantity_rule: use the exact source-spec notional and the same entry time and quantity for all four policies
historical_harness.episode_independence: freeze the baseline-generated entry rows once; replay every policy on every frozen row as an independent exit-policy episode, and do not let a candidate's longer or shorter holding period suppress or create later cohort entries
historical_harness.context_stratum_authority: ProtectionContext.trend_state derived causally at the entry decision

funding_authority.external_shadow_capture: for each admitted symbol, obtain anonymous public funding history covering from the earliest admitted entry_time_ms through campaign_end_ms+21600000 with startTime/endTime and limit=1000; paginate with cursor=newest_funding_time_ms+1 until cursor>endTime or a successful page contains fewer than 1000 rows; retain exact query/response hashes in the L60-07 run manifest; rows must be finite, strictly increasing and unique
funding_authority.historical_harness_source: use the existing per-symbol FundingDataset file addressed by signalbot.backtest.runner.funding_path for the frozen base spec; verify with signalbot.backtest.funding.verify_funding_dataset against exact symbol, data_start_ms, and evaluation_end_ms-1; bind every funding file SHA-256 in the L60-03 run manifest
funding_authority.missing_or_unverified_rule: missing file/page, failed exact-range verification, malformed/non-unique row, incomplete pagination, or unavailable funding authority makes the affected policy outcome primary-censored; do not substitute zero
funding_authority.zero_event_rule: zero funding return is valid only when the funding authority coverage is complete for the full policy holding interval and contains no strict-interior funding event

minimum_evidence.application_rule: evaluate every minimum-evidence floor separately for each challenger-vs-baseline comparison on that comparison's paired-valid primary-position intersection; direction, symbol, context-trend-state, and calendar-day counts all use those paired-valid rows; censor fraction remains separately defined over all admitted cohort positions
minimum_evidence.calendar_day_count_rule: count distinct UTC entry dates containing at least one paired-valid primary position for that challenger-vs-baseline comparison

numeric_precision.pass_fail_comparison: exact Decimal comparison with no display rounding; strictly-positive gates require value>Decimal('0')
numeric_precision.report_rounding: display-only, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, never used for pass/fail or tie detection
numeric_precision.tie_equality: exact Decimal equality before advancing to the next frozen tie-break

metric_definitions.censor_fraction: for each challenger comparison, count cohort positions for which either challenger or baseline lacks a valid primary outcome, divided by all admitted cohort positions
metric_definitions.maximum_drawdown: positive drawdown magnitude fraction; initialize each symbol sleeve at 1.0; apply each completed position multiplicatively as sleeve*=max(0,1+(after_cost_return_bps/10000)), ordered by (exit_time_ms,position_id); portfolio equity is the arithmetic mean of all symbol sleeves after each exit; at each step drawdown_magnitude=max(0,1-portfolio/previous_peak); maximum_drawdown=max(drawdown_magnitude)
metric_definitions.mean_mfe_giveback_fraction: MFE is policy-specific favorable excursion from common entry execution through that policy's exit; include full OHLC extremes only for fully completed bars strictly before the exit bar; on a gap-through exit use only the exit open; on an intrabar stop exit use the exit-bar open plus stop execution price but exclude that bar's favorable high/low because its ordering relative to the stop is unknowable; for positions with MFE_bps>0, mean(1-clamp(realized_directional_return_bps,0,MFE_bps)/MFE_bps)
metric_definitions.mean_stop_updates_per_24h_exposure: sum(post_admission_effective_stop_amendments)/(sum(exit_time_ms-entry_time_ms)/86400000); the cohort-entry active stop is not an update, duplicate/idempotent intents are not updates, and zero/nonpositive exposure is primary-censored
metric_definitions.premature_stop_rate: premature_stop_count/all_valid_paired_primary_positions_for_that_challenger; positions where the challenger does not exit prematurely contribute zero; zero denominator is invalid
metric_definitions.same_bar_ambiguity_count: count bars where the diagnostic one-R target and already-active stop are both touched; the event is never classified as a target win

outcome_semantics.ambiguity_rule: a stop computed from candle t is never active inside candle t; if the prior active stop is touched during t, the prior stop exit wins and no t-close amendment is applied
outcome_semantics.contiguous_price_gap_rule: when consecutive 5m slots are present and the next bar opens beyond the already-active stop in the adverse direction, fill at that bar open and record adverse gap-through slippage; this is a valid primary outcome
outcome_semantics.data_gap_rule: if one or more expected 5m slots are missing between the prior retained bar and the next retained bar, do not infer a stop fill across the missing interval; primary-censor the affected policy outcome
outcome_semantics.funding_boundary_rule: include only funding events with entry_time_ms < funding_time_ms < exit_time_ms; an event timestamp equal to entry or exit makes that policy outcome primary-censored
outcome_semantics.funding_return_rule: direction_sign is +1 LONG and -1 SHORT; for each strict-interior event use mark_price when it is present and positive, otherwise use entry_price, then funding_return_decimal += -direction_sign*funding_rate*funding_mark/entry_price; realized_signed_funding_bps=10000*funding_return_decimal
outcome_semantics.profit_target: NO_TARGET_EXIT; policy PnL is stop-or-max-holding only

premature_stop_definition.exit_order_rule: order exits by (bar_index,phase) with OPEN < INTRABAR < CLOSE; two INTRABAR exits in the same OHLC bar are unordered and neither is earlier for this diagnostic
premature_stop_definition.rebound_bar_rule: evaluate favorable excursion only on complete contiguous bars whose bar_index is strictly greater than the candidate exit bar_index and strictly less than the baseline exit bar_index; never use the baseline exit bar, even when its exit phase is CLOSE
premature_stop_definition.rule: a policy stop is premature only when its exit is strictly earlier than the delayed-ATR baseline under exit_order_rule and, under rebound_bar_rule, favorable excursion reaches at least one candidate-exit-time ATR from candidate exit price within the next 12 eligible fully subsequent bars; never use the remainder of the candidate exit bar or any baseline exit bar
premature_stop_definition.same_bar_unordered: if candidate and baseline are both INTRABAR exits in the same OHLC bar, classify the premature diagnostic as false rather than inferring intrabar order

outcome_semantics.same_bar_stop_fill: if an already-active stop lies inside a bar range and the bar open did not gap through it, fill at the stop price
outcome_semantics.same_bar_target_diagnostic: define one-R target from common entry and cohort-entry active stop: LONG target=entry+abs(entry-initial_stop), SHORT target=entry-abs(entry-initial_stop); if target and already-active stop are both touched in one OHLC bar, increment same_bar_ambiguity_count and never label the row a target win; target does not alter policy PnL exit
outcome_semantics.same_bar_terminal_rule: if an already-active stop is touched in the max-holding bar, the stop exit takes precedence over the close-based max-holding exit

policy_common_invariants.protection_floor: LONG new_stop>=protection_floor when present; SHORT new_stop<=protection_floor when present

rules.atr_candidate_not_active: no_stop_update; confirmed structure does not bypass the ordinary ATR/R activation gate

rules.weakening_state: confirmed structure stop is eligible when confirmed structure and explicit momentum weakening are both present, even if the normal ATR/R activation threshold has not yet been reached; otherwise use delayed_atr_trail_v1

primary_metric.paired_row_requirement: a row contributes to the primary metric only when both challenger and baseline have valid outcomes for the same cohort position

selection_rule.external_shadow_gate: must meet external_shadow minimum evidence, every numeric hard guardrail including strictly positive primary point estimate and familywise simultaneous lower bound, and censor/funding requirements
selection_rule.guardrail_population_rule: for each challenger-vs-baseline comparison, compute after-cost return, maximum drawdown, CVaR, premature-stop rate, MFE giveback, and stop-update-frequency candidate/baseline values on the exact same paired-valid position intersection used by that comparison; absolute candidate caps and candidate-minus-baseline deterioration limits both use this paired intersection; censor fraction alone uses all admitted cohort positions as denominator
selection_rule.historical_harness_gate: must meet historical_harness minimum evidence plus drawdown, CVaR, premature-stop, MFE-giveback, stop-update-frequency, censor, funding, and cost guardrails; historical primary point estimate and bootstrap lower bound are reported but are not promotion gates
